records.jp: あっ、えっと……す、すごい人だったんですね。^00ど、どうかお手柔らかに、お願いします……
records.en_original: Um... Y-you're really something, aren't you? I look forward to working with you...
records.en: Um... Y-you're really something, aren't you? I look forward to working with you...

records.jp: よろしくおねがいしますー……、新リーダーさん
records.en_original: Nice to meet you, Leader.
records.en: Nice to meet you, Leader.

records.jp: 世界のためだから受け入れよう。^00それだけだ……まだ何か用か？
records.en_original: I'm only doing this for the sake of the world. That's all. Do you need something else?
records.en: I'm only doing this for the sake of the world. That's all. Do you need something else?

records.jp: これからリーダーのこと、“お兄ちゃん”って呼ぶね。^00かんなたちのこと、よろしくね！　お兄ちゃん♪
records.en_original: From now on, I'm calling you "big brother." Please take care of all of us, big brother!
records.en: From now on, I'm calling you "Onii-chan." Please take care of all of us, Onii-chan!

records.jp: これからよろしくね～？　リーダー♪^00気になる子がいたら、お姉さんに相談してね～？
records.en_original: I'm looking forward to working with you from now on, Leader. If you have your eye on anyone, come ask me anytime, okay?
records.en: I'm looking forward to working with you from now on, Leader. If you have your eye on anyone, come ask me anytime, okay?

records.jp: いきなりメッセージが来ましたけど、^00いったい何が始まるんですか……？
records.en_original: I got a message out of nowhere. What exactly is going on?
records.en: I got a message out of nowhere. What exactly is going on?

records.jp: 転校初日から出動命令とは災難だね。^00お互い死なない程度に頑張ろうか
records.en_original: Tough luck getting called into action on your first day at a new school. Let's just try to make it through without getting ourselves killed, okay?
records.en: Tough luck getting called into action on your first day at a new school. Let's just try to make it through without getting ourselves killed, okay?

records.jp: もたもたしている暇はない。行くぞ！
records.en_original: We don't have time to waste. Let's go!
records.en: We don't have time to waste. Let's go!

records.jp: 今日も任務か～。あんまり気分乗らないな～……
records.en_original: Another mission, huh? I'm not really feeling it...
records.en: Another mission, huh? I'm not really feeling it...

records.jp: 初日から大変だと思うけど、困ったらいつでも^00お姉さんを頼ってくれていいからね～
records.en_original: I know starting on day one is tough, but if you ever need help, you can always count on your big sis.
records.en: I know starting on day one is tough, but if you ever need help, you can always count on your older sister.

records.jp: 任務が成功したいい雰囲気の時に話したいことでは^00なかったかな。いつかは伝えなきゃいけないんだけど
records.en_original: I didn't really want to ruin the good mood after a successful mission. Still, I knew I had to say it eventually.
records.en: I didn't really want to ruin the good mood after a successful mission. Still, I knew I had to say it eventually.

records.jp: 菜々花はこの頃どうしたんだ。^00辛いことがあったのは理解できるが……
records.en_original: What's been going on with Nanaka lately?  I understand that things have been rough, but...
records.en: What's been going on with Nanaka lately?  I understand that things have been rough, but...

records.jp: せっかくクイーン倒せたんだし、^00みんなもっと喜べばいいのに。ね、お兄ちゃん？
records.en_original: We managed to defeat a Queen, so everyone could be a bit happier about it. Don't you think so, big brother?
records.en: We managed to defeat a Queen, so everyone could be a bit happier about it. Don't you think so, Onii-chan?

records.jp: アレシアのこと、嫌いにならないであげてね^00あの子はあの子でいろいろ抱えてるから
records.en_original: Please don't hate Alesia. She has her own troubles, too.
records.en: Please don't hate Alesia. She has her own troubles, too.

records.jp: なーな……^00今はまだ動くときではない、神はそう言っているが……
records.en_original: Nana... Now's not the time to act. At least, that's what the Divine is telling me...
records.en: Nana... Now's not the time to act. At least, that's what the Divine is telling me...

records.jp: 森崎さん、わたしのプレゼントを^00気に入ってくれるといいんですが……
records.en_original: I hope Alesia will like my present...
records.en: I hope Morisaki-san will like my present...

records.jp: 任務と任務の間はしっかり休まないとね。^00いざって時にまた倒れたら申し訳ないし
records.en_original: We need to make sure to get some proper rest between missions. I'd feel terrible if I collapsed again when it really matters.
records.en: We need to make sure to get some proper rest between missions. I'd feel terrible if I collapsed again when it really matters.

records.jp: 休息も部隊の大切な仕事の一部だ。^00あれからきちんと休んだのか？
records.en_original: Taking breaks is also an important part of a squad's duties. Have you gotten proper rest in?
records.en: Taking breaks is also an important part of a squad's duties. Have you gotten proper rest in?

records.jp: 次の任務から詩帆とあなたに同行するわ。よろしく
records.en_original: I'll be joining you and Shiho starting with the next mission. I'm looking forward to working with you.
records.en: I'll be joining you and Shiho starting with the next mission. I'm looking forward to working with you.

records.jp: 次の任務も、ぱぱっと終わらせちゃお～！
records.en_original: Let's wrap up the next mission in a flash!
records.en: Let's wrap up the next mission in a flash!

records.jp: アレシアは自分の世界を持ってる子だから、^00詩帆と揉めないといいけど……
records.en_original: Alesia lives in her own little world, so I just hope she doesn't clash with Shiho...
records.en: Alesia lives in her own little world, so I just hope she doesn't clash with Shiho...

records.jp: ……次の任務はいつ頃だろうか。^00きららが出るかはわからないが……
records.en_original: ...I wonder when our next mission will be. I'm not sure if I'll be able to join or not, though...
records.en: ...I wonder when our next mission will be. I'm not sure if I'll be able to join or not, though...

records.jp: 森崎さんと仲良くなれて嬉しいです！^00本当はすごく優しい人だと思うんですよね
records.en_original: I'm so happy to have become friends with Alesia! I really think she's a great person.
records.en: I'm so happy to have become friends with Morisaki-san! I really think she's a great person.

records.jp: ２回続けて大手柄じゃん。^00私たちも結構やれるって思わせてくれて、嬉しいな
records.en_original: That's two big wins in a row! I'm glad you helped me realize that we can actually hold our own.
records.en: That's two big wins in a row! I'm glad you helped me realize that we can actually hold our own.

records.jp: ……初対面の時は、悪かった。^00これからもよろしく頼む
records.en_original: ...Sorry about how I acted when we first met. I hope we can get along from here on out.
records.en: ...Sorry about how I acted when we first met. I hope we can get along from here on out.

records.jp: 詩帆には申し訳ないことをしたと思っているの。^00……私だって、反省くらいはするわ
records.en_original: I feel bad for what I did to Shiho. ...Even I can reflect on my actions, you know.
records.en: I feel bad for what I did to Shiho. ...Even I can reflect on my actions, you know.

records.jp: 詩帆とアレシアが仲良くなれて良かったね～！^00２人が代わる代わる倒れるから、ドキドキしちゃった
records.en_original: I'm glad Shiho and Alesia have become such good friends! I was so nervous since one or the other kept getting knocked out.
records.en: I'm glad Shiho and Alesia have become such good friends! I was so nervous since one or the other kept getting knocked out.

records.jp: いろいろあったけど、結局あのプレゼントが^00詩帆とアレシアを結んでくれたみたいで良かった～
records.en_original: A lot happened, but in the end, it looks like that present brought Shiho and Alesia together, so I'm glad.
records.en: A lot happened, but in the end, it looks like that present brought Shiho and Alesia together, so I'm glad.

records.jp: アレシアとも上手くやっているのか、そうか……
records.en_original: So, you're getting along with Alesia as well... I see.
records.en: So, you're getting along with Alesia as well... I see.

records.jp: こんなところにいたのか。早く勉強会に行くぞ
records.en_original: So this is where you were. Come on, let's get to the study session already.
records.en: So this is where you were. Come on, let's get to the study session already.

records.jp: 場所がわからなくなっちゃった？^00勉強会は文芸部室でやるって由紀子が言ってたよ
records.en_original: Lost your way? Yukiko said the study group is being held in the literature club room.
records.en: Lost your way? Yukiko said the study group is being held in the literature club room.

records.jp: 安住さんもバディを亡くされていたんですね。気持ちは^00わかりますが、森崎さんは任務に出ていますし……
records.en_original: So Nanaka lost her partner, too. I understand how she feels, but Alesia is out on a mission right now...
records.en: So Azumi-san lost her partner, too. I understand how she feels, but Morisaki-san is out on a mission right now...

records.jp: ズバッと言っちゃうのが良くも悪くもアレシアだよね。^00菜々花にはアレシアの言葉が必要だったと思う
records.en_original: For better or worse, that's just how Alesia is—she always says exactly what's on her mind. I think Nanaka needed to hear that, though.
records.en: For better or worse, that's just how Alesia is—she always says exactly what's on her mind. I think Nanaka needed to hear that, though.

records.jp: どうしてこんな雰囲気が悪い時に^00異灰の襲撃があるんだ……
records.en_original: Why do the Testa have to attack at a time like this, when the mood is already so tense...?
records.en: Why do the Testa have to attack at a time like this, when the mood is already so tense...?

records.jp: 流石に言い過ぎたかしら。以前の菜々花なら^00もっと元気良く噛みついてきたと思うのだけど
records.en_original: Maybe I went a little too far. Before, Nanaka would have snapped back without a problem.
records.en: Maybe I went a little too far. Before, Nanaka would have snapped back without a problem.

records.jp: きららと菜々花が出れないのは仕方ないから、^00７人でぱぱっと片付けちゃおう！
records.en_original: We can't do anything about Kirara and Nanaka not being able to join us, so let's take care of this quickly with just the seven of us!
records.en: We can't do anything about Kirara and Nanaka not being able to join us, so let's take care of this quickly with just the seven of us!

records.jp: 菜々花も昔はもっと前向きだったんだけどね。^00樹里に懐いてたから、まだ立ち直れないんだと思う
records.en_original: Nanaka used to be a lot more positive, you know. She was really attached to Juri, so I don't think she's been able to recover yet.
records.en: Nanaka used to be a lot more positive, you know. She was really attached to Juri, so I don't think she's been able to recover yet.

records.jp: 申し訳ないが、今回も任務には参加できない。^00バディのなーなが一緒でないと……
records.en_original: I'm sorry, but I won't be able to join the mission this time either. I can't unless Nana, my partner, is with me...
records.en: I'm sorry, but I won't be able to join the mission this time either. I can't unless Nana, my partner, is with me...

records.jp: 安住さんとはいろいろありましたけど、^00これからは仲良くしていきたいです
records.en_original: We've been through a lot with Nanaka, but I hope we can get along from now on.
records.en: We've been through a lot with Azumi-san, but I hope we can get along from now on.

records.jp: 別の知り合いからお客さんが来るとは聞いてたけど、^00司令の言う「ＡＡＳＡ」っていったいなんなんだろう
records.en_original: I heard one of the Commander's acquaintances would be coming here as a guest, but what exactly is this "AASA" she mentioned?
records.en: I heard one of the Commander's acquaintances would be coming here as a guest, but what exactly is this "AASA" she mentioned?

records.jp: こないだまではサボっててごめん。^00やるからには、ちゃんと異灰をボコボコにしてあげる
records.en_original: Sorry for slacking off before. But now that I'm on it, I'll make sure to beat those Testa to a pulp.
records.en: Sorry for slacking off before. But now that I'm on it, I'll make sure to beat those Testa to a pulp.

records.jp: 戦闘指導とはまたいきなりだな。^00強くなれるのなら構わないが
records.en_original: Jumping straight into battle training, huh? Well, as long as it makes me stronger, I don't mind.
records.en: Jumping straight into battle training, huh? Well, as long as it makes me stronger, I don't mind.

records.jp: 戦闘指導、正直できるならパスしたいところね。^00休みは部屋でゆっくりしていたいもの
records.en_original: I'd honestly rather skip battle training if I could. I'd much prefer to relax in my room during my free time.
records.en: I'd honestly rather skip battle training if I could. I'd much prefer to relax in my room during my free time.

records.jp: 戦闘指導ってどんなことやるんだろうね～！^00体で教えてくれる先生だったらいいな～
records.en_original: I wonder what kind of things we'll do in battle training! I'd love it if the instructor taught us through hands-on experience.
records.en: I wonder what kind of things we'll do in battle training! I'd love it if the instructor taught us through hands-on experience.

records.jp: 外から講師の人を呼ぶなんて、司令もやる気だね～
records.en_original: The Commander must be really motivated to bring in an outside instructor.
records.en: The Commander must be really motivated to bring in an outside instructor.

records.jp: ……なーなが前を向けたのは良かった……と、思う
records.en_original: ...I'm glad Nana was able to come to terms with things and move on.
records.en: ...I'm glad Nana was able to come to terms with things and move on.

records.jp: こんにちは！^00……その、学校の中で迷っちゃって、えへへ……
records.en_original: Hello! Um, I sort of got lost inside the school. Hehe...
records.en: Hello! Um, I sort of got lost inside the school. Hehe...

records.jp: 平原さんの戦闘指導はすごかったですね。勉強には^00なりましたが、そもそも平原さんご自身が強すぎて……
records.en_original: Hiori's battle training was incredible. I did learn a lot, but honestly, she's just way too strong to begin with...
records.en: Hirahara-san's battle training was incredible. I did learn a lot, but honestly, she's just way too strong to begin with...

records.jp: 陽桜莉は知り合いから聞いてたとおりの人だったな。^00ああ見えて結構抱え込みやすいみたい
records.en_original: Hiori was exactly like how my friend described her. She may not look it, but she has a tendency to bottle things up.
records.en: Hiori was exactly like how my friend described her. She may not look it, but she has a tendency to bottle things up.

records.jp: 平原みたいな裏表がない人に限って言えない過去を^00抱えてたりするもんだけど……あくまで直感ね
records.en_original: People who wear their heart on their sleeve like Hiori tend to have the kind of past they can't talk about... That's just my intuition, though.
records.en: People who wear their heart on their sleeve like Hiori tend to have the kind of past they can't talk about... That's just my intuition, though.

records.jp: 自分たちも強くなったと自惚れていたが、^00まだまだだったと思い知らされたな。精進しよう
records.en_original: We were proud of how strong we'd gotten, but this showed us we still have a long way to go. Let's keep working hard.
records.en: We were proud of how strong we'd gotten, but this showed us we still have a long way to go. Let's keep working hard.

records.jp: 由紀子のおかげで陽桜莉が言っていたことは^00理解できたけれど、実践できるかはまた別の問題ね
records.en_original: Thanks to Yukiko, I was able to understand what Hiori was saying, but actually putting it into practice is another matter entirely.
records.en: Thanks to Yukiko, I was able to understand what Hiori was saying, but actually putting it into practice is another matter entirely.

records.jp: 感覚で教えてくれるタイプの先生で助かったよー。^00かんなは言ってること、だいたいわかったけどなあ
records.en_original: I'm glad she explained things through her senses. I pretty much understood what she was saying, though.
records.en: I'm glad she explained things through her senses. I pretty much understood what she was saying, though.

records.jp: 結構ハードなトレーニングだったから、みんな疲れてる^00みたい。今こそお姉さんの出番かな～？
records.en_original: That was some pretty tough training, so it looks like everyone's tired. Sounds like it's my time to shine, huh?
records.en: That was some pretty tough training, so it looks like everyone's tired. Sounds like it's my time to shine, huh?

records.jp: リーダーさんからの相談とは珍しいですね。^00文芸部室で待ってます
records.en_original: It's unusual for you to ask to talk about something, Leader. We'll be waiting in the literature club room.
records.en: It's unusual for you to ask to talk about something, Leader. We'll be waiting in the literature club room.

records.jp: 準備ができたら部室まで来てね
records.en_original: Come to the club room when you're ready.
records.en: Come to the club room when you're ready.

records.jp: あんたの方が相談ってどういう風の吹き回し？^00ま、力になれそうなら手伝うけど
records.en_original: What's got you coming to us for advice? Well, if I can help, I guess I'll lend a hand.
records.en: What's got you coming to us for advice? Well, if I can help, I guess I'll lend a hand.

records.jp: 今さら改まってどうした。^00詳しいことは部室で聞くが
records.en_original: What's with the sudden formality? Fill us in on the details in the clubroom.
records.en: What's with the sudden formality? Fill us in on the details in the clubroom.

records.jp: 全員を集めて話したいってことは、^00ここじゃ喋れない話題なのかしら
records.en_original: If you want to gather everyone and talk, does that mean it's something we can't discuss here?
records.en: If you want to gather everyone and talk, does that mean it's something we can't discuss here?

records.jp: いきなりどうしたの、お兄ちゃん。^00かんなにできることがあったらなんでも言ってね
records.en_original: What's wrong all of a sudden, big brother? If there's any way I can help, just let me know!
records.en: What's wrong all of a sudden, Onii-chan? If there's any way I can help, just let me know!

records.jp: 任務でもないのに呼び出しってことは、^00何か良くない事件があった？　お姉さん心配
records.en_original: If we're being called together, but it's not for a mission, does that mean something bad happened? I'm worried.
records.en: If we're being called together, but it's not for a mission, does that mean something bad happened? I'm worried.

records.jp: 末永くよろしくお願いしますね、^00リーダークン♡
records.en_original: Looking forward to a long and prosperous time together, dear Leader.
records.en: Looking forward to a long and prosperous time together, dear Leader.

records.jp: 久野さんのことも心配ですが、まずは皆さんが^00遠征から帰ってこられるよう、後方支援を頑張ります！
records.en_original: I'm worried about Kirara too, but for now, I'll do my best to support everyone from behind so you can all return safely from your expedition!
records.en: I'm worried about Kuno-san too, but for now, I'll do my best to support everyone from behind so you can all return safely from your expedition!

records.jp: 初めての遠征だし、体力付けて参加しないとね
records.en_original: This is our first expedition, so we'd better make sure we're in good shape before heading out.
records.en: This is our first expedition, so we'd better make sure we're in good shape before heading out.

records.jp: きららのために作戦を立てたのはいいけど、なんか^00あいつ、すでに自信満々じゃない？　逆に怖いんだけど
records.en_original: It's good that you came up with a plan for Kirara, but isn't she already bursting with confidence? Honestly, it's kind of scary.
records.en: It's good that you came up with a plan for Kirara, but isn't she already bursting with confidence? Honestly, it's kind of scary.

records.jp: 心配していても何も始まらない。遠征に出たら、^00常に本気で戦うだけだ
records.en_original: Nothing will change if we just sit around worrying. Once we're out on the expedition, we just have to fight with everything we've got.
records.en: Nothing will change if we just sit around worrying. Once we're out on the expedition, we just have to fight with everything we've got.

records.jp: 本気を出した菜々花なら、多少暴走してもなんとか^00なるんじゃないかしら。たぶん私の方が強いけれど
records.en_original: If Nanaka goes all out, I think things will work out even if she goes a little rampant. I'm probably still stronger than her, though.
records.en: If Nanaka goes all out, I think things will work out even if she goes a little rampant. I'm probably still stronger than her, though.

records.jp: 菜々花が前に出てぱーっとやっちゃうつもりなら、^00かんなも今回は張り切っちゃおうかな～
records.en_original: If Nanaka's going to step up and go all out this time, then maybe I'll give it my all, too.
records.en: If Nanaka's going to step up and go all out this time, then maybe I'll give it my all, too.

records.jp: 今回の遠征で、きららが自信を付けてくれるといいね～
records.en_original: I hope this expedition will help Kirara gain some confidence.
records.en: I hope this expedition will help Kirara gain some confidence.

records.jp: 次の任務では期待してくれたまえ。^00今までのきららとは違うところを見せる
records.en_original: Look forward to our next mission. I'll show you a side of me you've never seen before.
records.en: Look forward to our next mission. I'll show you a side of me you've never seen before.

records.jp: 遠征、上手くいくといいですね。くれぐれも、後ろから^00クイーンに襲われないよう注意してください♡
records.en_original: I hope the expedition goes well. Just be careful not to get ambushed by a Queen from behind.
records.en: I hope the expedition goes well. Just be careful not to get ambushed by a Queen from behind.

records.jp: 久野さんに何事もなくて良かったです
records.en_original: I'm glad nothing happened to Kirara.
records.en: I'm glad nothing happened to Kuno-san.

records.jp: 今どき迷惑メッセージ？^00そういうのは放っておいた方がいいよ
records.en_original: You got a spam message? It's best to just ignore that sort of thing.
records.en: You got a spam message? It's best to just ignore that sort of thing.

records.jp: きららの悩みに気づけなかったのはわたしも悪いし、^00今後はもうちょっとちゃんと話さないとね
records.en_original: It's partly my fault for not noticing Kirara's troubles. From now on, I need to make sure I talk with her properly.
records.en: It's partly my fault for not noticing Kirara's troubles. From now on, I need to make sure I talk with her properly.

records.jp: クイーンが出てきた時は驚いたが、全員の力で^00きららを救出できて良かった
records.en_original: I was surprised when the Queen appeared, but I'm glad we were able to save Kirara thanks to everyone working together.
records.en: I was surprised when the Queen appeared, but I'm glad we were able to save Kirara thanks to everyone working together.

records.jp: 何はともあれ、きららを助けられて良かった。^00……もう、仲間を殺すような目に遭うのはごめんだから
records.en_original: Anyway, I'm just glad we were able to save Kirara.^00...I never want to go through losing a comrade again.
records.en: Anyway, I'm just glad we were able to save Kirara.^00...I never want to go through losing a comrade again.

records.jp: きららが無事で良かったー！^00今度、また二人で特撮見るんだ～
records.en_original: I'm so glad Kirara is safe! We're going to watch more tokusatsu shows together!
records.en: I'm so glad Kirara is safe! We're going to watch more tokusatsu shows together!

records.jp: 詩帆にきらら、二人も心の中にクイーンが^00潜んでいたなんて、とても偶然とは思えないけど……
records.en_original: Both Shiho and Kirara having a Queen lurking within their hearts seems like more than just a coincidence...
records.en: Both Shiho and Kirara having a Queen lurking within their hearts seems like more than just a coincidence...

records.jp: 今回は迷惑を掛けてすまなかった。^00これからはなーなと二人でしっかりやっていく
records.en_original: Sorry for all the trouble I caused this time. From now on, Nana and I will handle things ourselves.
records.en: Sorry for all the trouble I caused this time. From now on, Nana and I will handle things ourselves.

records.jp: 皆さんがご無事で何よりです。^00未熟なクイーンで良かったですね
records.en_original: I'm just glad everyone is safe. It's a good thing she was an inexperienced Queen.
records.en: I'm just glad everyone is safe. It's a good thing she was an inexperienced Queen.

records.jp: わたしだけの呼び出しなんて、何があったんでしょうか。^00特に心当たりはないんですが……
records.en_original: I wonder why only I was called for. I can't think of any particular reason why that would be the case...
records.en: I wonder why only I was called for. I can't think of any particular reason why that would be the case...

records.jp: ユーコっていう子、凄いノリノリだったね。^00どうやったらあのテンションを維持できるんだろう
records.en_original: That girl, Yuko, was really hyped up, wasn't she? I wonder how she manages to keep up that level of energy.
records.en: That girl, Yuko, was really hyped up, wasn't she? I wonder how she manages to keep up that level of energy.

records.jp: うちの学校、制服だけじゃ部外者かどうか^00わかんないから、初めて会う人はだいたい警戒しちゃう
records.en_original: At our school, you can't really tell if someone's an outsider just by their uniform, so most people are pretty cautious around anyone they've just met.
records.en: At our school, you can't really tell if someone's an outsider just by their uniform, so most people are pretty cautious around anyone they've just met.

records.jp: 校内放送で個別の呼び出しとは、よほど急ぎなのか。^00また誰かが脱退しかけているわけじゃないといいが……
records.en_original: If someone's being called for individually over the PA system, it must be pretty urgent. I hope it's not because someone's about to quit again...
records.en: If someone's being called for individually over the PA system, it must be pretty urgent. I hope it's not because someone's about to quit again...

records.jp: 詩帆だけ特別に呼び出すなんて、親か知り合いでも^00訪ねてきたのかしら
records.en_original: If only Shiho is being called for, does that mean her parents are visiting or something?
records.en: If only Shiho is being called for, does that mean her parents are visiting or something?

records.jp: 校内放送だとやっぱり目立っちゃうね。^00司令もメッセージで呼び出せばいいのに
records.en_original: Being called for over the PA system really does make you stand out, huh? The commander could just call for us with a message instead.
records.en: Being called for over the PA system really does make you stand out, huh? The commander could just call for us with a message instead.

records.jp: ラーコちゃんの髪、すごくふわふわそうだったな～。^00ついお手入れしたくなっちゃった
records.en_original: Lako's hair looked so soft and fluffy. I couldn't help but want to start combing it.
records.en: Lako's hair looked so soft and fluffy. I couldn't help but want to start combing it.

records.jp: ユーコとラーコからほかの人と違う何かを感じたのだが、^00上手く言葉にできなくて背中がむずむず……
records.en_original: I felt something different from Yuko and Lako compared to everyone else, but I can't quite put it into words. It's making me feel all restless...
records.en: I felt something different from Yuko and Lako compared to everyone else, but I can't quite put it into words. It's making me feel all restless...

records.jp: 部室がずいぶん賑やかでしたが、何かあったのですか？
records.en_original: The clubroom was quite lively. Did something happen?
records.en: The clubroom was quite lively. Did something happen?

records.jp: 日菜子と久しぶりに話せて良かったです。日ノ杜で^00つながったご縁も前からの知り合いも、両方大切ですね
records.en_original: I'm glad I could talk with Hinako again after so long. The connections I've made here and my longtime friendships are both important to me.
records.en: I'm glad I could talk with Hinako again after so long. The connections I've made here and my longtime friendships are both important to me.

records.jp: 詩帆のこと、ちょっと羨ましいな。私は灰病に罹る^00前から病弱で、古い知り合いが少ないから
records.en_original: I'm a little jealous of Shiho. Even before I got Ash Syndrome, I was always frail, so I don't have many old friends.
records.en: I'm a little jealous of Shiho. Even before I got Ash Syndrome, I was always frail, so I don't have many old friends.

records.jp: 最近どんどん人来るじゃん。^00日ノ杜の評判も上がってきたかんじ？
records.en_original: Seems like we've been getting more and more visitors lately. Is Hinomori’s reputation on the rise?
records.en: Seems like we've been getting more and more visitors lately. Is Hinomori’s reputation on the rise?

records.jp: リーダーの古巣の新人なら、相当実力があるんだろうな
records.en_original: If she's a new member from your old school, then she must have some real talent.
records.en: If she's a new member from your old school, then she must have some real talent.

records.jp: 当たり前のことだけれど、詩帆にもこれまで築いてきた^00人間関係があるのよね……普段意識しないけれど
records.en_original: It should be obvious, but Shiho has her own relationships from before coming to this school. It's not something I usually think about, though.
records.en: It should be obvious, but Shiho has her own relationships from before coming to this school. It's not something I usually think about, though.

records.jp: 広島から人が来るんだって！　楽しみだね。^00どんな話しよっかな～
records.en_original: I heard someone is coming from Hiroshima! I can't wait. I wonder what we should talk about.
records.en: I heard someone is coming from Hiroshima! I can't wait. I wonder what we should talk about.

records.jp: 広島って、リーダーが前までいたところだよね。^00今度来る人は知り合いだったりする？
records.en_original: You were in Hiroshima until you came here, right? Do you know the person who's coming this time?
records.en: You were in Hiroshima until you came here, right? Do you know the person who's coming this time?

records.jp: 詩帆が楽しそうで何より。きららの古い知り合いは……^00いや、暗い話はやめておく
records.en_original: I'm just glad to see Shiho having fun. Kirara's old acquaintances were... No, I shouldn't bring up such gloomy stories.
records.en: I'm just glad to see Shiho having fun. Kirara's old acquaintances were... No, I shouldn't bring up such gloomy stories.

records.jp: ここ最近は人の出入りが激しいですね。きちんと戸締り^00していないと、悪い何かが入ってくるかもしれませんよ
records.en_original: There have been a lot of people coming and going lately. If you don't make sure to lock up properly, something bad might sneak in.
records.en: There have been a lot of people coming and going lately. If you don't make sure to lock up properly, something bad might sneak in.

records.jp: ＡＡＳＡからは、私以外にも何人か日ノ杜に^00お邪魔し続けると思いますが、よろしくお願いします
records.en_original: I think there will be a few others from AASA visiting Hinomori besides me, so I hope you'll welcome them as well.
records.en: I think there will be a few others from AASA visiting Hinomori besides me, so I hope you'll welcome them as well.

records.jp: えーっと……生徒指導室ってどっちですか？
records.en_original: Um...which way is the student counseling room?
records.en: Um...which way is the student counseling room?

records.jp: 星崎さんは明るい人でしたね。わたしの方が^00元気をもらってしまいました
records.en_original: Ao was such a cheerful person. She lifted my spirits.
records.en: Hoshizaki-san was such a cheerful person. She lifted my spirits.

records.jp: 打ち合わせだっけ？　文芸部室で待ってるから
records.en_original: You want to have a meeting? I'll be waiting in the literature club room.
records.en: You want to have a meeting? I'll be waiting in the literature club room.

records.jp: 込み入った話なら部室でお願い。^00作戦は頭に叩き込んでおきたいし
records.en_original: If it's something complicated, let's talk it over in the clubroom. I want to make sure I get the strategy memorized.
records.en: If it's something complicated, let's talk it over in the clubroom. I want to make sure I get the strategy memorized.

records.jp: 準備が整ったら部室に来てくれ。^00打ち合わせを始めよう
records.en_original: Come to the clubroom when you're ready. We'll start the meeting then.
records.en: Come to the clubroom when you're ready. We'll start the meeting then.

records.jp: 立ち話は打ち合わせの後でもいいかしら。^00やるべきことは早めに終わらせておきたいの
records.en_original: Can we save chatting for after the meeting? I'd like to get business out of the way first.
records.en: Can we save chatting for after the meeting? I'd like to get business out of the way first.

records.jp: 愛央ともうちょっとだけ話したかったなー……^00なんて、話せることももうあんまりないんだけどね
records.en_original: I wanted to talk with Ao a little longer... Not that there's really much left to say, though.
records.en: I wanted to talk with Ao a little longer... Not that there's really much left to say, though.

records.jp: 愛央が来てから、かんなが少しだけ元気を^00なくしてるみたい。お姉さん心配だな……
records.en_original: Kanna has seemed a little down ever since Ao came. I'm a bit worried about her...
records.en: Kanna has seemed a little down ever since Ao came. I'm a bit worried about her...

records.jp: 愛央……きららにとっては不可思議な存在だった……。^00掴みどころがないというかなんというか……
records.en_original: Ao was such an enigma. It's hard to pin her down, or maybe that's not quite it...
records.en: Ao was such an enigma. It's hard to pin her down, or maybe that's not quite it...

records.jp: ようやく落ち着きましたし、そろそろ次の遠征を、^00といったところでしょうか？　ただの勘です♡
records.en_original: Things have finally calmed down, so maybe it's time for our next expedition? That's just a hunch, though.
records.en: Things have finally calmed down, so maybe it's time for our next expedition? That's just a hunch, though.

records.jp: ゆっくり眠れる場所があるなら安心ですね。^00準備ができたら出発しましょう！
records.en_original: It would be reassuring to have a place where we can sleep soundly. Let's head out when you're ready!
records.en: It would be reassuring to have a place where we can sleep soundly. Let's head out when you're ready!

records.jp: さっきの打ち合わせの時、メイの顔が少し^00暗かったように見えたんだけど、大丈夫かな
records.en_original: Mei seemed a bit down during the meeting earlier. I wonder if she's okay.
records.en: Mei seemed a bit down during the meeting earlier. I wonder if she's okay.

records.jp: 道のりは長いって言ってたじゃん。^00さっさと出発した方がいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: You said the journey was going to be long, right? Shouldn't we get moving already?
records.en: You said the journey was going to be long, right? Shouldn't we get moving already?

records.jp: ……すまない、考えごとをしていた。^00体調に問題はない。準備ができたらすぐ出発しよう
records.en_original: ...Sorry, I was lost in thought. I'm feeling fine. Let's head out as soon as you're ready.
records.en: ...Sorry, I was lost in thought. I'm feeling fine. Let's head out as soon as you're ready.

records.jp: ちゃんとしたベッドがあるのなら、^00文句を言う人もいないでしょうね
records.en_original: I doubt anyone would complain if there are proper beds to sleep in.
records.en: I doubt anyone would complain if there are proper beds to sleep in.

records.jp: 前はいろいろあって大変だったけど、^00今回はみんな無事に帰ってこれるといいね！
records.en_original: We went through a lot last time, but I hope everyone makes it back safely this time!
records.en: We went through a lot last time, but I hope everyone makes it back safely this time!

records.jp: 長期遠征は負担が大きいから、困ったことがあったら^00いつでもお姉さんを頼ってね～
records.en_original: Long expeditions can be tough, so if you ever run into trouble, don't hesitate to rely on your big sister.
records.en: Long expeditions can be tough, so if you ever run into trouble, don't hesitate to rely on your older sister.

records.jp: ……話したいことがあるのだが、今は間が悪い。^00遠征中、タイミングがあれば話す
records.en_original: ...There's something I want to talk about, but now isn't a good time. I'll bring it up during the expedition if I get the chance.
records.en: ...There's something I want to talk about, but now isn't a good time. I'll bring it up during the expedition if I get the chance.

records.jp: 今回は私も同行しま～すっ！　何か起きたら、^00いつでも言ってくださいね♡
records.en_original: I'll be coming along this time, too! If anything comes up, just let me know.
records.en: I'll be coming along this time, too! If anything comes up, just let me know.

records.jp: バタバタしていましたがようやく落ち着きましたし、^00チャンスがあれば皆さんにご馳走を作りますね！
records.en_original: Things have finally settled down after all the commotion. If I get the chance, I'll cook a nice meal for everyone!
records.en: Things have finally settled down after all the commotion. If I get the chance, I'll cook a nice meal for everyone!

records.jp: エーテル周りの仕組みは能力でだいたいわかったから、^00同じ薬が作れないか、今度こっそり試してみようかな
records.en_original: I've got a pretty good understanding of how Ether works now, so maybe I'll secretly try making that kind of medicine myself.
records.en: I've got a pretty good understanding of how Ether works now, so maybe I'll secretly try making that kind of medicine myself.

records.jp: 今回は生駒に助けられたけど、^00あいつ本当に何者なの……？
records.en_original: Ayami saved us this time, but who exactly is she...?
records.en: Ayami saved us this time, but who exactly is she...?

records.jp: リーダーのおかげで駒川を抑えられているのは幸いだが、^00やはり落ち着かないものは落ち着かないな……
records.en_original: Thanks to you, we can keep Uta under control, but I still can't help feeling uneasy.
records.en: Thanks to you, we can keep Uta under control, but I still can't help feeling uneasy.

records.jp: 信用なんて最初からしていなかったけれど、^00いざ敵とわかると、やっぱり、と思ってしまうものね
records.en_original: I never trusted her from the start, but now that I know that she's an enemy, I can't help but feel that it was obvious.
records.en: I never trusted her from the start, but now that I know that she's an enemy, I can't help but feel that it was obvious.

records.jp: 女の子にはいろいろ秘密があるものなの。^00お姉さんは顔が広い、これで十分でしょ？
records.en_original: Girls have their share of secrets. All you need to know is that your big sis has plenty of connections, okay?
records.en: Girls have their share of secrets. All you need to know is that your older sister has plenty of connections, okay?

records.jp: 詩を警戒していて良かった。^00もっと早くに皆と相談すべきだったな
records.en_original: Good thing I was wary of Uta. I should have discussed things with everyone sooner.
records.en: Good thing I was wary of Uta. I should have discussed things with everyone sooner.

records.jp: リーダークン、ご命令はなんですか♡^00……ああんっ、無視しないで～っ♡
records.en_original: What are your orders, dear Leader? ...Aww, don’t ignore me!
records.en: What are your orders, dear Leader? ...Aww, don’t ignore me!

records.jp: 普段あれだけ落ち着いている生駒さんの相談ですから、^00よほど重大なことなんでしょうね……
records.en_original: Ayami's usually so calm, so if she wants to talk to all of us about something, it must be really serious...
records.en: Ikoma-san's usually so calm, so if she wants to talk to all of us about something, it must be really serious...

records.jp: 集合場所は文芸部室だよ。隊員の悩みなんだから、^00ちゃんと聞き届けないと
records.en_original: Meet in the literature club room. Since one of our team members is troubled, we need to make sure to listen carefully.
records.en: Meet in the literature club room. Since one of our team members is troubled, we need to make sure to listen carefully.

records.jp: 生駒が改まって呼び出すくらいなんだから、^00よっぽど大事なんでしょ。さっさと部室行こ
records.en_original: If Ayami went out of her way to call us together, it must be really important. Let's head to the clubroom.
records.en: If Ayami went out of her way to call us together, it must be really important. Let's head to the clubroom.

records.jp: リーダーからの相談もこの頃減ったが、彩未からの^00相談はもっと珍しいな。何事もないといいが……
records.en_original: You've been asking for advice a lot less lately, but Ayami asking to talk is even more rare. I hope everything's all right...
records.en: You've been asking for advice a lot less lately, but Ayami asking to talk is even more rare. I hope everything's all right...

records.jp: 彩未から話題を持ち出すなんて、^00相当気になることがあるのね
records.en_original: If Ayami's bringing something up, it must really be bugging her.
records.en: If Ayami's bringing something up, it must really be bugging her.

records.jp: 心配のしすぎならいいんだけど、^00気になったことがあって……
records.en_original: I hope I'm just overthinking it, but there’s something that's been bothering me.
records.en: I hope I'm just overthinking it, but there’s something that's been bothering me.

records.jp: きららもなんとなく背中がむず痒くなってきた。^00ただの緊張であってほしいが……
records.en_original: I've got a weird feeling going down my spine. I hope it's just nerves...
records.en: I've got a weird feeling going down my spine. I hope it's just nerves...

records.jp: 何やらそわそわしていますね。何が起きているのか、^00飼い主として教えてください、リーダークン♡
records.en_original: You seem a little restless. As my owner, won't you tell me what's going on, dear Leader?
records.en: You seem a little restless. As my owner, won't you tell me what's going on, dear Leader?

records.jp: いよいよ最後の戦いなんですね。心残りはたくさん^00ありますが、準備ができたら戻りましょう
records.en_original: So, the final battle is upon us. There are still so many things I wish I could have done, but let's head back out when you're ready.
records.en: So, the final battle is upon us. There are still so many things I wish I could have done, but let's head back out when you're ready.

records.jp: 灰病になってから十分自由を楽しめたけど、どうせなら、^00もうちょっとわがまま言いたかった、かな
records.en_original: I've enjoyed plenty of freedom since I caught Ash Syndrome, but if it's all going to come down to this, I wish I'd have been a little more selfish.
records.en: I've enjoyed plenty of freedom since I caught Ash Syndrome, but if it's all going to come down to this, I wish I'd have been a little more selfish.

records.jp: 夢なんて１つも叶ってない。でもわたし、全然諦めて^00ないから。別の世界にでも転生して、アイドルになる
records.en_original: None of my dreams have come true. But I haven't given up at all. Even if I have to be reborn in another world, I'll become an idol.
records.en: None of my dreams have come true. But I haven't given up at all. Even if I have to be reborn in another world, I'll become an idol.

records.jp: ユキや菜々花、部隊全員のおかげで、この数ヶ月は^00本当に充実していた。思い残すことはない。行くぞ！
records.en_original: Thanks to Yuki, Nanaka, and everyone in the squad, these past few months have truly been fulfilling. I have no regrets. Let's go!
records.en: Thanks to Yuki, Nanaka, and everyone in the squad, these past few months have truly been fulfilling. I have no regrets. Let's go!

records.jp: 本当に世界が終わってしまうのね。いざ滅ぶとなると、^00心残りも……ないとは言えない
records.en_original: The world really is coming to an end. Now that the moment is upon us... I can't say I have no regrets.
records.en: The world really is coming to an end. Now that the moment is upon us... I can't say I have no regrets.

records.jp: お兄ちゃんと一緒に、わたしはこの世界で死ぬ。^00その覚悟だけはちゃんと受け取ってほしい
records.en_original: I'm ready to die in this world together with you, big brother. That's the one thing I want you to understand.
records.en: I'm ready to die in this world together with you, Onii-chan. That's the one thing I want you to understand.

records.jp: ……世界が終わる前に、溜め込んでいた秘密を^00打ち明けられる人ができて、良かった
records.en_original: ...I'm glad I found someone I could finally tell all the secrets I've been keeping, before the world comes to an end.
records.en: ...I'm glad I found someone I could finally tell all the secrets I've been keeping, before the world comes to an end.

records.jp: いよいよ世界の終末か。辛い過去も山ほどあったが、^00最後くらいは前を向いていたいものだ
records.en_original: So, the end of the world is finally upon us. I've had my share of hardships, but at the very least, I'd like to face the end with my head held high.
records.en: So, the end of the world is finally upon us. I've had my share of hardships, but at the very least, I'd like to face the end with my head held high.

records.jp: 世界がこうなったのは、私のせい。できる限り^00全部の責任を私が取る。ごめんね、みんな……
records.en_original: This is all my fault. I'll take full responsibility for everything, as much as I can. I'm sorry, everyone...
records.en: This is all my fault. I'll take full responsibility for everything, as much as I can. I'm sorry, everyone...

records.jp: 詩ちゃんと、たぶんまた戦うんだよね。世界が^00滅んでも、お互いわかり合えないのかな……
records.en_original: I'll probably have to fight Uta again, won't I? Even if the world ends, will we never truly understand each other?
records.en: I'll probably have to fight Uta-chan again, won't I? Even if the world ends, will we never truly understand each other?

records.jp: 急かしたくはないけど、時間はもう残ってない。^00やりたいことを全部やったら、戦いに戻ろう
records.en_original: I don't want to rush you, but we're almost out of time. Once you've done everything you want, let's get back to the fight.
records.en: I don't want to rush you, but we're almost out of time. Once you've done everything you want, let's get back to the fight.
